column17: Talking, Words: Verbal communication is a direct way to convey emotions. Whether it’s saying “I love you” or “I’m feeling sad,” words carry emotional weight. Facial Expressions: Humans often use their faces to communicate emotions. A smile indicates happiness, while a furrowed brow might signal concern. Emojis and Emoticons: These tiny symbols add emotional context to text messages. For instance: 😊 (Happy) 😢 (Sad) 😡 (Angry) Gestures: Actions like hugging, patting someone on the back, or holding hands can express emotions without words. Art and Creativity: Music, poetry, paintings, and other forms of art allow us to express complex emotions that may be hard to articulate.
